caption:
The space station circles Earth 15.56 times a day. So why does a TV dish never move?

At 400 km up, one lap takes 92.56 minutes.
Higher up, gravity is weaker, so a satellite moves slower and takes longer.
At 35,786 km, one lap takes 23.93 hours. Earth turns at the same pace, so the satellite stays over one spot.
